# FrozenStart

A scenario of [EmployeeRecord](../employee-record.md).

The record starts frozen: HR staff read its name, and a clerk thaws it.

## Object states

The states objects are in, in lifecycles other than the one the scenario runs. A lifecycle not given takes the state the object's
bound value maps to, else its initial state. Frozen says whether the object, or a link of it, starts frozen: it can't be modified or deleted, and its links
can't be connected or disconnected, until a thaw.
